parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh-CN**: Chinese.

- **en-US**: English.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The client generates this value. The value must be unique among different requests. It can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

parameters.name: ConfigId
parameters.description: The ID of the instance configuration. For the same access domain name and GTM instance, you can configure both A and AAAA records. This creates two instance configurations. \`ConfigId\` uniquely identifies an instance configuration.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Global Traffic Manager (GTM) 3.0 instance.
